lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters organized into approximately five horizontal rows and four vertical columns posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular spots, forming a distinct lattice or matrix across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible, specifically one attached above the branchial region and several others positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin.
